content.text:
I finished the campaign and submitted index 21 (Mg 0.60 / Mn 0.40) as the best composition. Its photocurrent was only 1e-8 A, but it was the only one of my three samples to give a nonzero signal.

This result is weak. With only three merit measurements for 28 candidates, I measured three spread-out compositions:

| Index | Mg / Mn | Photocurrent | Why I picked it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 0.33 / 0.67 | 0 A | MgMn₂O₄ spinel composition |
| 21 | 0.60 / 0.40 | 1e-8 A | middle of the Mg-rich range |
| 26 | 0.81 / 0.19 | 0 A | Mg-rich end |

- **Gaps:** I measured nothing on the Mn-rich side (Mg below 0.3), so that half of the library is unknown. I also never ran the GP suggestion tool.
- **XRD not used:** All 5 XRD measurements went unused, and I made no phase identification.
- **Signal size:** 1e-8 A is barely above zero. Index 21 comes out ahead of the other two, but I can't say it is anywhere near the library's best.
